question: What was missed when the Henrietta investigation is read backwards from current CS2 assets, schemas and UI into the initial CS2 beta?

primary_findings.finding: The initial CS2 packaged manifest already contained generated econ inventory images named pet_hen_1, and the current packaged manifest still contains the same pet_hen_1 family.
primary_findings.render_suffix_note: heavy/medium/light and large are inventory image rendering variants; they are not evidence of biological growth stages.
primary_findings.implication: A literal PET+HEN asset family existed from the initial CS2 beta era, replacing the weaker earlier reliance on secondary reports of an unknown Pets category.

primary_findings.finding: Historical Panorama iteminfo.js explicitly treated default loadout slot 'pet' as an equippable non-weapon slot and recognized item definition names containing 'pet_' for inventory-image rendering.
primary_findings.implication: pet_hen_1 was backed by explicit pet-slot and pet-item UI architecture before the Henrietta poster appeared.
Pet identity became an explicit field in the CS2 economy preview transport months before the Train Henrietta poster.

primary_findings.finding: Current CS2 ships Chicken.Chick.Interact, six chicken_chick audio files and a substantial chick animation set including idle, react, walk, run, squat, fall, land and swim variants. The initial 2023 packaged manifest did not contain the searched chick animation/audio names.
primary_findings.implication: The chicken system now has explicit juvenile/chick presentation and interaction support. This makes an egg-to-chick-to-adult concept technically more plausible, but does not prove an implemented growth pipeline.

primary_findings.finding: Current client C_Chicken contains m_bIsPreviewModel plus C_AttributeContainer and m_bAttributesInitialized; server CChicken contains IHasAttributes, CAttributeContainer, leader and follow timers.
primary_findings.implication: The ordinary chicken class has a dedicated client preview-mode path and attribute machinery. This is architecturally compatible with pet/econ presentation but does not prove that every preview chicken is a pet.

primary_findings.finding: chicken_metadata defines weighted material groups and material parameters with a Seed Generation Value.
primary_findings.implication: Chicken appearance can be generated from model metadata, fitting the existence of multiple Catalan visual variants. Direct mapping to pet_hen_1 remains to be demonstrated.

primary_findings.finding: CEconItemPreviewDataBlock gained style, variations and upgrade_level while petindex already existed.
primary_findings.implication: The preview transport can carry an upgrade level, but the field is generic and must not be treated as proof of pet growth stages.

negative_and_corrective_findings.reason: PET in that filename refers to Particle Editor Tool, not companion pets.
It lives in generic base_gcmessages.proto and has no demonstrated CS2 chicken-pet callsite.
mainmenu.js references it, but no functional implementation/callsite was established in tracked emitted source.
The current loadout_grid.js declares the structure, but exact-file search found only the declaration.
Do not infer literal stickers applied to pets without additional evidence.
Runtime video confirmed a visible generic chicken/rooster in the MVP presentation path; no Henrietta-specific identity marker was present.

reverse_chronology: 2023-03-22: pet_hen_1 econ image family already packaged in initial CS2 beta manifest
2024-02-08: Panorama UI explicitly recognizes pet slot and pet_ item-definition names
2024-10: Chicken.Chick.Interact and Chicken.Interact development breadcrumbs appear before Train return
2024-11: Train returns with missing named hen Henrietta poster
2025-07-02: preview block gains style, variations and generic upgrade_level
2025-2026: pet placement/nameable/XP-shop egg ownership infrastructure becomes explicit
2026-current: pet_hen_1 images persist; chick sounds/animations are packaged; C_Chicken has preview mode; egg_pristine remains referenced by tooling/FGD but absent from current runtime manifest

strongest_model.claim: Henrietta is most plausibly the diegetic narrative face or breadcrumb of a long-running hen PET system that predates the Train poster, rather than a currently hidden physical chicken on de_train.

required: Henrietta string in pet item/localization/schema/model metadata, or
official Valve statement directly linking Train Henrietta poster to the pet_hen item/system, or
reproducible unique runtime pet object whose identity maps to Henrietta

next_targets: Extract and visually compare the five pet_hen_1 inventory renders against the Train Henrietta poster.
Find the item-schema definition/defindex backing pet_hen_1 and inspect its attributes, default slot, rarity, capabilities and localization tokens.
Trace exact relationship between chick animations/sounds and the adult chicken model/metadata.
Search localization and item schema for Henrietta, hen, chicken egg and pet_hen identifiers.
